title: nyctocalos cuspidatum
intro: Nyctocalos cuspidatum, commonly known as the "Night-blooming Gloriosa", is a species of flowering plant in the family Colchicaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and pain, due to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and analgesic properties. The therapeutic actions of Nyctocalos cuspidatum include its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate pain, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as arthritis and muscle soreness. The bioactive constituents of this plant include colchicine and other alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
